title: phaseolus vulgaris var. turcicus
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. turcicus, commonly known as Turkey bean or Adzuki bean, is a variety of the common bean plant, which is a type of legume that belongs to the family Fabaceae. The health benefits of Turkey bean include its potential to help manage diabetes due to its high fiber and protein content, as well as its ability to reduce cholesterol levels and improve heart health. The therapeutic actions of Turkey bean are attributed to its antidiabetic, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of diabetes, arthritis, and other inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Turkey bean include polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins, which have been shown to possess antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties.
